plainTranslation: A's identity meets B's identity. The square puts them in friction.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Your core directions rub against each other, wanting different things at the same time. Respect can curdle into a contest of wills. Take turns being the one who's right.
tension: The harder part is when everything starts feeling personal. You may read their confidence as arrogance. They may read yours the same way. A normal difference in style can start to feel like disrespect, even when neither person means it that way.
advice: Not every difference is a challenge to answer. Sometimes the other person is just being themselves, not trying to outshine you. The more you can remember that, the easier it is to stop turning friction into a competition.
summaryShort: Your core directions rub against each other, wanting different things at the same time.
